description: This file contains automated tests for the Playwright CLI commands using the testing framework. It verifies behaviors such as help output, code generation, and browser installation via npx, including checks for downloaded software and disk installation.

methods.name: test('npx playwright --help should not download browsers')
methods.description: Tests that the help command does not trigger browser downloads and verifies specific output.

methods.name: test('npx playwright codegen')
methods.description: Tests that invoking codegen with npx outputs a message about downloading browsers and handles errors appropriately.

methods.name: test('npx playwright install global')
methods.description: Tests the installation process of browsers via npx, verifying downloads and disk installation, with platform-specific skipping.

calls: expect(result).not.toContain(`To avoid unexpected behavior, please install your dependencies first`)
expect(stdio).toContain(`Please run the following command to download new browsers`)
test.skip(process.platform === 'win32', 'isLikelyNpxGlobal() does not work in this setup on our bots')

ctags.name: result
ctags.pattern: /^  const result = await exec('npx playwright install');$/

ctags.name: stdio
ctags.pattern: /^  const stdio = await exec('npx playwright codegen', { expectToExitWithError: true });$/
